project-built-ins-and-porch.html.title: Built-ins & Porch
project-built-ins-and-porch.html.lede: A slate built-in with matching wainscot, and a porch floor laid out in a two-grey diamond.
project-built-ins-and-porch.html.facts: <dt>Location</dt><dd>Greater Burlington</dd><dt>Type</dt><dd>Residential, interior and porch</dd><dt>Surfaces</dt><dd>Cabinetry, wainscot, porch floor, ceiling</dd><dt>Prep</dt><dd>Degloss, sand, bonding primer</dd><dt>Finish</dt><dd>Satin enamel, porch and floor enamel</dd>
project-built-ins-and-porch.html.palette:
Slate#5B6675
Wall white#F1F0EC
Porch grey#9EA3A2
Taupe#6E655B
text: Built-ins are furniture. They are sanded between coats, finished smooth and left to cure before anything goes back on the shelves.
Outside, the porch floor was taped and painted in a diamond pattern under a bright white beadboard ceiling.

project-dealership.html.title: Auto Dealership
project-dealership.html.lede: A storefront that has to look sharp every day, painted on a schedule that kept the lot open.
project-dealership.html.facts: <dt>Location</dt><dd>Chittenden County</dd><dt>Type</dt><dd>Commercial, exterior</dd><dt>Surfaces</dt><dd>Metal panel, canopy, soffit</dd><dt>Prep</dt><dd>Degrease, scuff, metal primer</dd><dt>Finish</dt><dd>Industrial enamel</dd>
project-dealership.html.palette:
Clean white#F2F3F2
Signal red#C1272D
Silver panel#B9BEC3
Charcoal#3B3F44
text: A commercial facade is seen from the road and from the front door. We worked in sections so sales carried on.
Metal panel, canopy and soffit were cleaned, primed and coated for an even finish. Our crews are experienced on lifts for work at this height.

project-lake-cottage.html.title: Lake Cottage
project-lake-cottage.html.lede: A lakeside camp in deep lake blue, with white rails and a screened porch ready for many more summers.
project-lake-cottage.html.facts: <dt>Location</dt><dd>Lake Champlain</dd><dt>Type</dt><dd>Residential, exterior</dd><dt>Surfaces</dt><dd>Clapboard, porch, rails, deck</dd><dt>Prep</dt><dd>Wash, scrape, board repair, prime</dd><dt>Finish</dt><dd>Satin body, gloss rails</dd>
project-lake-cottage.html.palette:
Lake blue#4F6F93
White trim#F1F1EE
Metal roof#A9AEB0
Deck grey#8A8C86
text: Houses on the lake take sun, wind and water from every side. Failing paint came off, soft boards were replaced, and everything was primed before color went on.
Rails and porch details are picked out in white, so the cottage reads clearly from the water and the road.

project-library.html.title: Library & Community Hall
project-library.html.lede: Clean white walls against timber and stone, with an open stair finished to gallery standard.
project-library.html.facts: <dt>Location</dt><dd>Greater Burlington</dd><dt>Type</dt><dd>Commercial, interior</dd><dt>Surfaces</dt><dd>Walls, ceilings, stair, restrooms</dd><dt>Prep</dt><dd>Patch, sand, prime new drywall</dd><dt>Finish</dt><dd>Scrubbable eggshell</dd>
project-library.html.palette:
Gallery white#EDEEEB
Ash timber#D9BE97
Black steel#1E1F1E
Fieldstone#A69E8E
text: Public buildings need tough finishes and a crew that works around people. We went room by room so the building stayed open.
The timber and fieldstone were left as they are. The walls are there to let the wood and the daylight do the work.

project-queen-anne-victorian.html.title: Queen Anne Victorian
project-queen-anne-victorian.html.lede: Spindles, brackets and fish-scale shingle, each one scraped, primed and cut in by hand.
project-queen-anne-victorian.html.facts: <dt>Location</dt><dd>Burlington</dd><dt>Type</dt><dd>Residential, exterior</dd><dt>Surfaces</dt><dd>Clapboard, shingle, porch, trim</dd><dt>Prep</dt><dd>Lead-safe scrape, sand, prime, caulk</dd><dt>Finish</dt><dd>Satin body, semi-gloss trim</dd>
project-queen-anne-victorian.html.palette:
Cream siding#E6D9A8
White trim#F4F2EA
Slate blue#3F5D7A
Slate roof#8D9196
text: A Queen Anne rewards patience. Every bracket and baluster is its own small job, on wood that has seen a century of Vermont winters.
The crew worked lead-safe from the first scrape and kept the porch open for the family throughout.

project-red-shingle-colonial.html.title: Red Shingle Colonial
project-red-shingle-colonial.html.lede: Cedar shingle in barn red, black shutters and white trim.
project-red-shingle-colonial.html.facts: <dt>Location</dt><dd>Chittenden County</dd><dt>Type</dt><dd>Residential, exterior</dd><dt>Surfaces</dt><dd>Cedar shingle, trim, shutters</dd><dt>Prep</dt><dd>Wash, scrape, spot-prime</dd><dt>Finish</dt><dd>Flat body, satin trim, gloss shutters</dd>
project-red-shingle-colonial.html.palette:
Barn red#8E3B2C
Black shutter#24272A
White trim#F2F1EC
Grey door#BFC0BC
text: Shingle drinks paint. Even color across thousands of edges means brushing every course and keeping a wet edge the whole way across a wall.
Shutters came down, the trim went back to bright white, and the house kept its New England face.

project-sigma-phi-house.html.title: Sigma Phi House
project-sigma-phi-house.html.lede: Four Corinthian columns, a full pediment and a fanlight entry, made crisp again against red brick.
project-sigma-phi-house.html.facts: <dt>Location</dt><dd>Burlington</dd><dt>Type</dt><dd>Exterior</dd><dt>Surfaces</dt><dd>Columns, pediment, cornice, windows, door</dd><dt>Prep</dt><dd>Scrape, consolidate, spot-prime</dd><dt>Finish</dt><dd>Gloss trim, natural oak door</dd>
project-sigma-phi-house.html.palette:
Brick#7A3B2E
Column white#F2F0EA
Limestone#D9D2C3
Oak door#8A5A35
text: Classical trim shows everything. Capitals, dentils and the fanlight over the door are slow work, done by hand from the right equipment.
We worked around a busy house, protected the steps and plantings, and left the entry looking the way it was built to look.
